exercises.name: Stationary bike warm-up
exercises.desc: Seat height so the knee keeps a slight bend at the bottom. Low resistance, smooth circles. Warms the joint and primes the quads without impact.

exercises.name: Goblet box squat to bench
exercises.desc: Hold one dumbbell at the chest, sit back to a bench at about knee height, pause lightly, stand. Knee tracks over the 2nd toe, torso upright to spare the lower back.

exercises.name: Leg press (back supported, 0-90 deg)
exercises.desc: Back and hips pressed into the pad. Lower to about 90 degrees only; do not let the pelvis curl under. Press through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Seated leg extension
exercises.desc: Slow: 2 sec up, 3 sec down, in a comfortable range. Moderate weight. Builds the quadriceps that support the knee.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.desc: Trains hamstrings, which stabilise the knee, without hip-hinging like a deadlift. Slow lowering.

exercises.name: Low step-up (15-20 cm), left leg lead
exercises.desc: Whole left foot on the box, drive up through the heel, lower for 3 sec. Do not push off the trailing foot. Start with a low box; hold dumbbells later and switch weighted to true if wanted.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.desc: Band above the knees, slight quarter-squat, step sideways without letting the knees cave in. Builds glute medius for knee alignment.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise (machine)
exercises.desc: Full range, 1 sec pause at the top. Calves help absorb load at the knee.

exercises.name: Front plank
exercises.desc: Forearms and toes, straight line, ribs down, glutes squeezed. Core endurance protects the lower back.

exercises.name: Rowing machine warm-up
exercises.desc: Easy pace, drive with the legs through a short knee range, upright torso. If the back feels tight, use the bike instead.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row machine
exercises.desc: Chest on the pad removes lower-back load. Pull elbows back, squeeze shoulder blades, control the return.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press (back supported)
exercises.desc: Bench at 30 degrees, back flat on the pad, press up and slightly together.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.desc: Sit tall, pull the bar to upper chest, elbows down, do not lean back far.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press (back supported)
exercises.desc: Use a back pad, do not arch. Press overhead and lower under control.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.desc: Rope at face height, pull toward the face with elbows high, squeeze rear shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.desc: Elbows tucked at sides, extend fully, control up.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.desc: Back on an incline bench, arms hang behind the body, curl without swinging.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.desc: On your back, arms up, knees at 90. Lower opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays pressed to the floor.

exercises.name: Side plank (each side)
exercises.desc: Forearm under shoulder, hips lifted in a line. Bend the knees if needed.

exercises.name: Pallof press (cable)
exercises.desc: Side-on to a cable at chest height, press the handle straight out and resist rotation.

exercises.name: Machine hip abduction
exercises.desc: Sit upright, push pads out slowly, control the return. Builds outer hip muscles that steady the knee.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.desc: Feet flat, push through heels, lift until shoulders, hips and knees align; do not over-arch. Squeeze glutes 1-2 sec.

exercises.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat (hold support)
exercises.desc: Back foot on a bench, lower with torso upright and front knee over the toes. Hold a rack for balance. Left side first; start shallow.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg press (left leg emphasis)
exercises.desc: One foot on the plate, press to near full extension, lower to about 90 degrees. Do left first, match reps on the right.

exercises.name: Band terminal knee extension
exercises.desc: Band behind the knee anchored to a rack, knee slightly bent, straighten fully and squeeze the quad.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.desc: Sit tall, neutral spine, pull to the belly, squeeze shoulder blades, do not rock.

exercises.name: Wall sit (knees ~60-70 deg)
exercises.desc: Back flat on the wall, thighs about 60-70 degrees from straight. Gentle static quad hold.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.desc: On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg, pelvis level.

exercises.name: Dumbbell farmer carry
exercises.desc: Dumbbells at your sides, stand tall with ribs down, walk steadily. Enter the weight of each dumbbell.

exercises.name: Steady bike, Zone 2
exercises.desc: Conversational pace (about 60-70% max heart rate). Burns calories with no knee impact.

exercises.name: Intervals: bike or cross-trainer (1 min hard / 2 easy)
exercises.desc: After a 3-5 min warm-up, alternate 1 min hard (effort 7-8/10) with 2 min easy. Keep resistance moderate.

exercises.name: Mobility: quad, hip flexor, calf stretches
exercises.desc: Hold each stretch 30 sec per side.

exercises.name: Incline treadmill walk 5-8% (or swim / elliptical)
exercises.desc: Brisk incline walk, no handrails, short stride. Swim or elliptical alternative.

exercises.name: Easy walk + mobility
exercises.desc: Low-intensity walk plus foam rolling quads/glutes and hip stretches. Do not roll on the kneecap.
